---
title: "Projects"
description-meta: "Course and side projects by Jacob Johnson"
title-block-banner: false

# Styles: the first file is shared with the Publications and Presentations
# pages (buttons, dividers, title and date layout, abstract toggle); the
# second adds the few project-specific pieces.
css:
  - files/publications/pub-listing.css
  - files/projects/project-listing.css

# Publish the reports and other files linked from projects.yml.
resources:
  - files/projects/*.pdf

# The page content comes from a Quarto listing:
#   contents  -> the data (edit this to add projects)
#   template  -> how each entry is drawn
listing:
  - id: projects
    contents: files/projects/projects.yml
    type: custom
    template: files/projects/project-listing.ejs
    sort: false        # the template sorts newest first
    page-size: 200     # show everything on one page (no pagination)
---

This is a space for work outside my published research, such as course projects. Each includes a short description and links to code, documents, etc.


:::{#projects}
:::
